judgment.reason: Report.json was produced with required structure, but the underlying optimization is unreliable: the agent used a linearized LP ignoring quadratic costs, assumed reserve cost as 10% of energy cost (unsupported default), and had unit-conversion confusion in LMP/reserve duals. Validation showed a negative LMP (bus 9: -$32.52) and base line 64-1501 flow 315.48 MW exceeding its 312 MW limit, indicating constraint/dual errors. Cost figures (~$298M/hr) and binding-line counts are suspect, so results are not trustworthy.
